title: Sparkly aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FF8A65'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E64A19'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4FC3F7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0288D1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='20,30 32,34 32,46' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <polygon points='20,30 32,34 33,40' fill='#FFAB91'/>

  <!-- horizontal tail -->
  <polygon points='18,44 32,43 32,47 19,48' fill='#29B6F6'/>

  <!-- main body -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='48' rx='34' ry='11' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='44' rx='33' ry='5' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='43' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E1F5FE'/>

  <!-- main wings -->
  <polygon points='50,52 66,52 58,74 42,74' fill='url(#wing)'/>
  <polygon points='52,52 62,52 58,66 48,66' fill='#81D4FA' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='54,52 64,52 62,66 54,66' fill='#01579B' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- engine pods -->
  <rect x='46' y='64' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <rect x='46' y='64' width='14' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#FFF176'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='89' cy='48' r='4' fill='#FFCC80'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='47' r='1.4' fill='#FFF3E0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF59D'>
    <polygon points='20,14 22,19 27,20 22,22 20,27 18,22 13,20 18,19'/>
    <polygon points='42,10 43.5,14 47,15 43.5,16.5 42,20 40.5,16.5 37,15 40.5,14'/>
    <polygon points='74,16 76,21 81,22 76,24 74,29 72,24 67,22 72,21'/>
    <polygon points='88,66 89.5,70 93,71 89.5,72.5 88,76 86.5,72.5 83,71 86.5,70'/>
    <polygon points='14,70 15.5,74 19,75 15.5,76.5 14,80 12.5,76.5 9,75 12.5,74'/>
    <polygon points='36,84 37,87 40,88 37,89 36,92 35,89 32,88 35,87'/>
    <polygon points='64,86 65.5,90 69,91 65.5,92.5 64,96 62.5,92.5 59,91 62.5,90'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='14' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='82' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='60' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='1.4'/>
  </g>
</svg>
